about: Shared test vector for src/app/signoff.mjs (mail.dev.a, 24 Nov 2026). For each draft, canon is the exact UTF-8 string that is hashed: draft_sha256 = lowercase SHA-256 hex of canon, no newline; the signed string is draft_sha256 + batch_id. The hashes are not stored here (the leak scan refuses long hex); the test computes them, and they are sent by message. Signatures are checked with a fresh key per test run; no private key is stored.
